notes.title: Tumble Patch 1.1001
notes.content:
Heya! Long time no see!
I took a break, left and never came back. The game didn't attract an audience I was hoping for which left my motivation and mental health in shambles. This is a tiny patch, which includes:
-changed the banners in character selection menu
-fixed a few issues with the gameplay

I don't expect to come back to this project full time again, however a mobile release is most definitely coming- I have it working on my phone, only a few minor tweaks are needed for publishing on the Google Play Store. Going forward you can expect a few discounts- most notably next week, starting april 4th. Don't forget to buy it for your whole family if you haven't already!

Thank you, take care, stay hydrated, 

Aleq

notes.title: TUMBLE 1.1 CHRISTMAS UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi there! As promised this update is slightly bigger and brings a few much requested features and fixes:
-Settings menu is now scrollable to allow more space for future options
-Added vsync! No more choppy frames 
-The game is now properly optimized 
-Plague slightly buffed:
*Miwaku phase cooldown decreased 19>>14
*Health increased 8000>>8500
-Fixed a few missing textures ;))

Merry christmas and have a good day!

notes.title: TUMBLE 1.02 HOTFIX
notes.content:
Hey there! This isn't the big update I talked about last time but it's a much bigger patch that fixes all known issues to date, including:
-spikes dealing damage when hidden
-red vignette effect turning on when damage=0
-gofung death animation looping
-boss music volume louder than intended
-character selection screen torches moving
-Miwaku's ghosts not appearing

Other changes include:
-Venya fireball damage 40>>35
-Gofung acid damage 5>>6
-Gofung acid ball damage 30>>35
-Plague base attack damage 25>>30
-Plague cooldowns reduced
-Cancelling Volt's ultimate gives back 3 points
-Enemies killed by Volt's projectile now give ultimate points
-Level 6 saws now move independently
-Character selection screen banners changed 

Thanks for playing and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: TUMBLE 1.01 HOTFIX
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

First of all, thank you for the support! All of your positive responses are appreciated! 

This hotfix is for a few minor bugs including:
-Fixed an issue with spikes not dealing any damage
-Disabled the terminal window from showing when the game is launched
-Fixed wrong order of textures in level 9

We'll be back soon with a more major update, so stay tuned!
